---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: A new feature or improvement
labels: 'feature request, state: to triage'
assignees: ''

---

## Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you're requesting.
 
## Contact *(optional)*
Preferred way to reach you outside GitHub (e.g. email, Discord). Leave blank if GitHub is fine.
 
## Motivation
What problem does this solve, or what need does it address?
(e.g. "Currently I have to manually do X every time, which causes Y...")
 
## Proposed Solution
Describe how you'd like this to work, as clearly as you can.
 
## Examples or Links
Any real-world examples, references, or links that illustrate the idea.
 
## Alternatives You've Used
Any workarounds you're currently using, or other approaches you've considered.
 
## Additional Context
Any screenshots, mockups, or extra information that helps explain the request.
 
## Would you like to work on this?
- [ ] Yes, I'd like to submit a PR for this
- [ ] No, I'm just suggesting it
- [ ] Maybe, I'd need some guidance
